To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a microsomal enzyme system of rabbit kidney medullary tissue catalyzes the synthesis of prostaglandins, the enzyme system is solubilized by treatment with a nonionic detergent, the solubilized enzymes can be purified by adsorption chromatography and the purified enzymes catalyze the synthesis of prostglandins.
a solubilization and purification procedure was developed for prostaglandin synthetase of kidney medulla, and that the partially purified enzyme catalyzed the formation of prostaglandins H2 and G2.
a solubilize enzyme preparation from the microsomes of the rabbit kidney medulla was obtained and partially purified by adsorption to and elution from an omega- amino-octyl Sepharos 4B column.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purification of prostagladin endoperoxidase synthetase from the microsomes of renal medulla and with the characterization of the enzyme.
the solubilization of prostaglandins synthetase from rabbit kidney medulla and with the partial purification of the enzyme.
the development of a simple and reproducible method to solubilize and partially purify the microsomal prostaglandin synthetase system from rabbit kidney medulla.

prostaglandin synthesis is a complex process involving multiple enzymes and cofactors.
